R-001.title: Recurring lessons never pre-create instance rows

R-002.title: Levels, evaluation categories, exercises, notification config and player notes are coach-scoped

R-003.title: All lessons belong to a club

R-004.title: Many-to-many relationships use explicit association tables with an `id` primary key

R-005.title: Business logic lives in `padel_app/services/`; route handlers stay thin

R-006.title: Tests import service functions inside the test body

R-007.title: DB operations in tests and scheduler jobs run inside `with app.app_context():` — one context, one session

R-008.title: Integration tests patch external I/O and inject `now=`

R-009.title: JWT is accepted in the Authorization header everywhere, and in the `?token=` query string only on the SSE endpoint

R-010.title: Scheduler job ids follow the fixed naming scheme

R-011.title: Web imports use the `@/` alias, never relative `../../` paths

R-012.title: All HTTP calls go through `@levelup/api`; never call axios from a component or screen

R-013.title: Playwright locators: role > placeholder > label > text > CSS, and a role's name is resolved from the locale files, never typed

R-014.title: Real-time updates arrive over SSE (`/api/app/events`); never poll

R-015.title: Web UI uses the Radix/shadcn primitives in `src/components/ui/`; no competing UI library

R-016.title: Messages are soft-deleted via `is_deleted`, never hard-deleted

R-020.title: Editing an instance that diverges from its parent lesson records the diverging fields in `overridden_fields`

R-022.title: The backend serialises API responses in camelCase

R-023.title: Event timestamps are naive UTC; class, block and request times are naive Lisbon wall-clock

R-024.title: Anything added to `apps/web` is added to `apps/mobile` in the same ticket

R-025.title: On mobile, a font weight is reached by naming the family, never by fontWeight

R-026.title: A clickable card or list row is a real control, not a styled div with onClick

R-027.title: SSE fan-out is per-process: one gunicorn worker until a shared broker exists

R-028.title: The production database is backed up nightly off the VM, and the backup fails loudly or proves restorable

R-029.title: When two things must mean the same, test them against each other — never each against a constant

R-030.title: Backend tests run on SQLite with foreign keys enforced and on Postgres built by the real migrations

R-031.title: Resolving a spec conflict in a batch: establish which side is stale and take the current one — never assume the batch's is newer

R-032.title: A test proves it found its subject before asserting anything about it

R-033.title: Work you did not write is adopted under your name, with what you re-ran and what you inherited labelled apart

R-034.title: A fix is proven by four runs, not one

R-035.title: Prove a procedure by enumerating its commands against what the system actually runs

R-036.title: Operational identifiers stay out of the tracked knowledge layer; docs/ is local and disposable

R-037.title: A migration-walk test uses raw SQL for the oldest schema it meets, and always returns the scratch database to head

R-040.title: An E2E spec removes what it wrote to the shared database, and asserts on its own rows
